title: Build the frontend before Cloudflare preview upload
description:
## Problem

The flashcards Cloudflare preview trigger runs pnpm install --frozen-lockfile as its build command and then pnpm --filter app exec wrangler versions upload as its deploy command. The deploy command expects app/dist, but no Vite build creates it, so every preview check fails before upload.

## Evidence

PR #126 frontend build ef0e410b installed successfully and failed during deploy with: the assets.directory path /opt/buildhome/repo/app/dist does not exist. The same commit passed GitHub CI and the API preview. Locally, pnpm --filter app build creates app/dist and the exact Wrangler upload succeeds with --dry-run.

## Scope

Correct the frontend preview trigger so it builds the current commit before versions upload. Preserve the guarded production command pnpm deploy:production:frontend and do not move production traffic during verification.
acceptance_criteria: A frontend branch preview runs pnpm --filter app build before Wrangler versions upload; the resulting Cloudflare check succeeds with a Static Assets SPA preview version and no production traffic change; the production trigger remains pnpm deploy:production:frontend.

Retry build 829c518e succeeded and created Static Assets preview v7c0972ad; PR #126 frontend check is green, both preview URLs return HTTP 200 HTML, and production remains 100% on reviewed v182 e3357085.

title: Preserve API secrets across main Cloudflare deployments
description:
## Problem

A successful merge to main triggers the configured Cloudflare production API build. The resulting Worker version can contain the correct production non-secret bindings but omit the versioned DIAG_GUARDIAN_EMAIL secret binding, silently disabling designated-operator access.

## Evidence

After PR #123 merged, automatic API version 179 preserved production D1, allowlist, Resend, sender, rate limiter, GUARDIAN_EMAIL_ALLOWLIST, and RESEND_API_KEY, but omitted DIAG_GUARDIAN_EMAIL. Production was immediately restored to reviewed v167.

## Scope

Correct the main-branch Cloudflare API deployment workflow so it preserves required versioned secret bindings or stages and verifies a candidate before traffic moves. Add a regression gate that rejects automatic production versions missing required secret names.
acceptance_criteria: A main-branch API deployment cannot move production traffic to a version missing DIAG_GUARDIAN_EMAIL, GUARDIAN_EMAIL_ALLOWLIST, or RESEND_API_KEY; the candidate is verified against production bindings before traffic changes; a controlled main-path test leaves operator access functional and all protected identity states correct.

title: Make phonemic-awareness cards runnable by non-specialist guardians
description:
## What happened

A phonemic-awareness card tells the adult and child to “Blend /a/ and /t/.” and says “Listen for: at.” A guardian without teaching or speech-language training may not know who should say each sound, how to present the task, or what “blend” asks the child to do.

## What I expected

The card gives a plain-language caregiver script that makes the roles explicit: what the adult says or models, what the child should do, and what response counts as correct. Completing the activity should not require familiarity with teacher/SLP terminology.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Start a Kindergarten practice session as a non-specialist guardian.
2. Reach the phonemic-awareness card for combining /a/ and /t/.
3. Try to conduct and score the activity using only the instructions on screen.
4. Observe that the verb “blend” and the “Listen for” answer do not explain how to administer the task.

## Additional context

This is one authored item today, but the behavior should be a reusable phonemic-awareness instruction pattern rather than a one-off copy edit. For example, the screen can distinguish an adult cue such as “Say /a/. Say /t/. Now put the sounds together.” from “Child says: at.” Final instructional wording should receive curriculum/owner review. Recorded modeling or advanced scaffolds are separate work.
acceptance_criteria: Every phonemic-awareness card presents caregiver-ready directions that explicitly distinguish the adult cue/model from the child response and correct-answer guidance. Instructions use plain language, remain usable without teacher/SLP knowledge, and are covered by rendering/content tests. The /a/ + /t/ card is verified on a 375px family device with no blocking caregiver confusion.

title: Redirect to the guardian dashboard after creating a student

After creating a student, the Add a student form stays on screen and shows a small success sentence with an Open dashboard link. The successful state change is easy to miss and requires another tap.

A successful creation automatically returns the guardian to the guardian dashboard, where the newly created student is visibly listed.

1. Sign in as a guardian.

3. Enter a first name and grade, then choose Create student.
4. Observe that the form remains open instead of returning to the guardian dashboard.

## Additional context

Observed for both a Kindergarten student and a Grade 1 student during the production family-device QA pass. The canonical onboarding journey ends at guardian home after creation.

title: Evaluate guardian-confirmed automatic speech scoring
description:
# Evaluate guardian-confirmed automatic speech scoring

## User Story
As a guardian, I want the app to propose a speech score that I can confirm or override, so environmental noise or recognition mistakes never silently affect mastery.

## Business Motivation
Automatic scoring could reduce guardian effort and make practice feedback more immediate, but child speech recognition, background noise, privacy, and false confidence create material learning and trust risks. Without an explicit investigation, an implementation could silently corrupt mastery state or introduce an inappropriate audio-processing dependency.

## Context & Grounding
- Code: app/src/components/cards/PhonicsCard.tsx:9-26 currently makes guardian taps authoritative; api/src/routes/practice.ts:17-25 and 143-207 accept only guardian_tap and update mastery immediately.
- Domain terms: guardian, student, attempt, mastery, scoring source, guardian confirmation.
- ADRs: docs/adrs/002-phase-a-audio-strategy.md separates playback from scoring and requires explicit user gestures.
- Related work: rw-1gz.8.2 builds playback only; it must remain decoupled from future microphone capture and scoring.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Compare browser, on-device, and server-assisted recognition approaches for child speech.
- Evaluate phoneme-level and whole-word accuracy, latency, browser support, privacy, and cost.
- When the system proposes a score, the system shall require guardian confirmation or override before mastery changes.
- The design shall preserve both proposed and confirmed results for reliability analysis without storing raw audio by default.
- Given noisy conditions such as a door opening, competing speech, or variable microphone distance, when recognition runs, then the evaluation shall measure proposal quality and guardian override behavior.
- Document consent, child-privacy, and third-party processing implications.
- Produce an architecture recommendation, prototype scope, and explicit go/no-go criteria.
- Explicitly assess scoring-source schema changes around api/src/routes/practice.ts and guardian controls in app/src/components/cards/PhonicsCard.tsx.

## Technical Notes
Keep playback, microphone capture, recognition, score proposal, guardian confirmation, and mastery persistence as separate boundaries. Guardian-confirmed results remain authoritative. Avoid storing raw child audio by default. Consider append-only attempt semantics and whether proposal telemetry belongs on attempt rows or a separate event record.

## Definition of Done
Research and prototype evidence documented; privacy and architecture review completed; target-device tests include noisy conditions; recommendation and go/no-go decision recorded; follow-up implementation work split into independently deliverable slices if approved.

## Disposition
HITL — privacy policy, recognition provider, acceptable accuracy thresholds, and go/no-go criteria require human decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Guardian confirmation remains authoritative; approaches, accuracy, privacy, cost, noisy-condition behavior, schema impact, and go/no-go criteria are documented.

title: Magic-link rate limiting before broad access
description: C6 / ADR-001 guardrail. Add rate-limiting to magic-link creation before broadening beyond the trusted micro-pilot. Single-use tokens already covered (auth.ts sets consumed_at). Not required at micro-pilot scale; track for the second wave.
design: Use unexpired auth_token rows as an exact rolling attempt ledger: one INSERT ... SELECT statement inserts only when the normalized guardian email has fewer than 3 rows with expires_at after request time. D1 processes each database's queries one at a time and each query runs in an implicit transaction, so the conditional read and write cannot interleave. Enforce after allowlist validation and idempotent guardian creation but before provider delivery. Concurrent guardian creation uses INSERT OR IGNORE then re-read. Throttled requests return empty 204. On delivery failure, mark the token consumed so the attempt counts until expiry without remaining usable. For open access with Resend, also require the production Cloudflare rate-limit binding and trusted source-IP header, hash the IP key, and enforce a fail-closed 10/IP/minute abuse backstop. Allowlist and dev-log flows do not use the IP limiter.
acceptance_criteria: Magic-link creation is rate-limited before broad/public access is opened.
notes: TDD evidence on branch plan/rw-1gz-7-4-magic-link-rate-limit: RED 1 fourth sequential request returned 200 instead of 204; GREEN conditional auth_token insert. RED 2 four concurrent starts produced guardian.email uniqueness 500s; GREEN idempotent guardian creation.
